context: A uni student interviews a retired champion about training
purpose: Teach: 兼/収め/カッコ/役に立つ/世界一/珍しく/的確/なるべく

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はお時間ありがとうございます。先生は現役時代、世界一の座を三度も収められたんですよね。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. You claimed the world champion title three times during your career, didn't you?
lines.style: Polite university student opening an interview with respectful admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: はは、もう昔の話だよ。当時はコーチ兼トレーナーという人に、なるべく毎日厳しく見てもらっていてね。
lines.en: Haha, that's old news now. Back then I had someone serve as both coach and trainer, watching me strictly almost every day.
lines.style: Warm elderly tone, modest deflection, reminiscing fondly about past.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そのコーチの指導は、やはり的確だったんですか?
lines.en: Was your coach's guidance really that precise and on point?
lines.style: Curious follow-up question, leaning forward with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、的確すぎて怖いくらいだった。私が珍しく弱音を吐いた日も、彼の一言で目が覚めたんだ。
lines.en: Yes, so precise it was almost frightening. Even on the rare day I complained, one word from him snapped me awake.
lines.style: Reflective elder voice, vivid memory, slight chuckle of respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: カッコいいですね。若い選手たちにとって、本当に役に立つお話だと思います。
lines.en: That's so cool. I think this is genuinely useful advice for young athletes today.
lines.style: Earnest student admiration, slightly star-struck and casual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 役に立つかな。今の子は情報が多すぎて、何を信じればいいか迷うだろうね。
lines.en: I wonder if it really helps. Kids today have too much information and probably get lost choosing what to trust.
lines.style: Humble musing tone of older mentor, gentle concern.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最後にひとつ。後輩たちへ、なるべく早く伝えたい教訓はありますか?
lines.en: One last question. Is there a lesson you'd like passed on to younger athletes as soon as possible?
lines.style: Closing interview question, polite and direct conclusion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだな、基礎を疎かにするな、ということ。地味な反復こそが本物の力になる。
lines.en: Let me think — never neglect the basics. Plain, repetitive practice is what builds real strength.
lines.style: Gravely wise elder, final piece of life advice delivered.
